items.text: Warp 0 loads the 8 partials and reduces them with shuffles
Thread 0 writes the block's sum (or `atomicAdd`s it to the global total)
Each warp reduces its 32 values with `__shfl_down_sync`
Lane 0 of each warp writes the warp's partial sum to shared memory
Each thread loads (or sums, with a grid-stride loop) its values into a register
